highlights: Major AI companies are rapidly releasing new, specialized models and extending enterprise offerings, with Anthropic launching Claude Fable/Mythos 5.2, OpenAI introducing GPT-6 Cyber for security, and ChatGPT Enterprise becoming available on AWS Marketplace.

Significant advancements in AI infrastructure and developer tools are emerging, including Google's new TPUs for long-context agents and confidential inference, and open-source solutions like LoRazor and AutoEMatic optimizing LLM serving and inference efficiency.

The focus on AI agent capabilities and practical applications is intensifying, with Baidu introducing an automated research system, Google enhancing coding agents, and OpenAI expanding educational initiatives for widespread AI literacy.

agents.title: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records
agents.summary: Baidu's ERNIE Evolve is an automated research system capable of editing code, running experiments, and integrating verified gains, demonstrating record-breaking performance in accelerating AI development and inference.

agents.title: Google AI Releases Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin for Spec-First Coding
agents.summary: Google AI's new Elephant-Goldfish Model plugin empowers coding agents to prioritize drafting specifications and conducting multiple zero-context review stages before code generation, significantly enhancing code quality and reliability.

agents.title: AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind
agents.summary: AVCORP introduces a corpus and training method enabling LLM-based agents to identify and resist deception by inferring user beliefs and goals, significantly enhancing agent robustness in complex interactions.

models.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
models.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber, a frontier cybersecurity model engineered to identify and fix exploitable vulnerabilities while operating within authorized scopes, significantly enhancing AI-driven security defenses.

models.title: Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters
models.summary: Zyphra launched ZONOS3-Mini, an Apache 2.0 licensed open-source text-to-speech model featuring 100M active parameters, capable of voice cloning, word-by-word delivery steering, and real-time browser execution for dynamic audio applications.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work
models.summary: Meta introduced Muse Ember, a highly cost-effective and efficient small model designed for high-volume agent tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and document parsing, matching Claude Haiku 5.5 performance at a fraction of the cost.

tools.title: LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
tools.summary: LoRazor is a multi-LoRA serving framework that significantly boosts request throughput by dynamically releasing adapters early and optimizing GPU kernels, achieving up to 3.02x throughput gains with minimal accuracy impact for customized LLMs.

tools.title: AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement
tools.summary: AutoEMatic introduces a full-stack co-design for LLM inference that dynamically adapts precision for weights, activations, and KV cache at runtime, improving accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 while maintaining high throughput on GPUs and accelerators.

tools.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
tools.summary: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server specifically designed for AI agents, enabling high-volume code pushes and robust version control to streamline agent development workflows.

companies.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards
companies.summary: Anthropic released new Claude versions, Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, offering a single powerful model with two distinct safeguard levels to cater to diverse enterprise needs, featuring a 1M-token context window and competitive pricing.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
companies.summary: Google Cloud introduced Gemini for healthcare, a specialized solution designed to unify clinical data and automate complex workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burden and enhance efficiency in the medical sector.

companies.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
companies.summary: OpenAI has made ChatGPT Enterprise available through AWS Marketplace, simplifying the procurement process for organizations by leveraging their existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

learning.title: MoE Routing Strategies Explained: Top-K, Expert-Choice, Sigmoid Gating and Dynamic Routing (2026 Guide)
learning.summary: This comprehensive guide explains seven key Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing strategies, including Top-K and dynamic routing, detailing how experts process tokens and the models that utilize each method, crucial for advanced LLM development.

learning.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
learning.summary: OpenAI Academy is launching free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities, empowering caregivers with practical AI skills for daily life to improve efficiency and support.

learning.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
learning.summary: OpenAI is addressing the AI guidance gap in education through new ThinkYoung research and EMEA partnerships, focusing on supporting teachers, fostering AI literacy, and promoting independent learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled future.
